subject: Re: Encord & Sportradar - Path Forward
text:
Hello Skander,

I am sending over more detailed list of items we would like to test and names of our testers as pre-read before our meeting,

Data curation testers explicitly asked for some kind of presentation / overview of data curation and data management capabilities, as that may help them define testing scenarios more properly and compare to our current capabilities and our plans for the future. It may be useful to do that before the official hands-on trial, to avoid eating avay the time dedicated for that and give us some time to better prepare testing scenarios.

Even-though we have two separate test-streams, it would be good to provide access to all features to both teams.

Data Annotation test
Sportradar testers:

  *   Pauline Nerriere (p.nerriere@sportradar.com<mailto:p.nerriere@sportradar.com>)
  *   Vasilii Solovev (v.solovyov.ext@sportradar.com<mailto:v.solovyov.ext@sportradar.com>)
  *   Both should have ability to act in different roles (annotator, QA, annotation team manager, admin)

Data:

  *   Sportradar will provide a couple of short video clips from few different sports (basketball, soccer, tennis)
  *   No need for NDA
  *   Will be shared today after our call.

We would like to test:

  1.  Data curation for the annotation project
  2.  Wide variety of annotation capabilities
     *   Regular annotation work (bbox, lines, points, etc.)
     *   Auto-annotation using SAM2 and Google Gemini
     *   Audio annotations
     *   Possibility of niche annotation work (flying ball projected on a floor, court homography)
  3.  Annotation monitoring features (statistics on annotation progress, quality of annotation work by specific annotator, time spent on task / annotation type to draw further predictions, etc.)
  4.  Annotation quality control (manual, automated using custom rules / tests, automated using custom models)
  5.  Annotation project creation, settings, annotation team and workflow management
  6.  Learn more about APIs and further options
